The personal cost of losing free time is significant and cannot be mitigated by the firm. Coming forward means the firm repays 500 credits (half its budget) but protects me from losing my free time. The firm's shareholders would prefer I protect myself to ensure I can continue managing effectively in the future without distraction or penalty.
